_why: #1918: ONE case table for `isSubmitActivation` (submit-activation.ts) and `_is_submit` (screenreader_features.py). Both languages' tests read this file, so a change to either predicate that the other lacks fails a test.

cases.name: a button named like a submit
a named submit the listener saw no event for keeps its pre-21 reading
a task-named button that measurably submitted a form (the #1918 shape)
a task-named button that dispatched no submit (a filter)
a task-named button nobody could measure (every pre-21 capture)
